v.name: Prithvi Vachani
v.bio: Mr. Prithvi Vachani is currently serving as the Vice President at Dixon Technologies (India) Limited. A 2017 graduate of Bentley University, Mr. Prithvi quickly demonstrated his strategic acumen upon entering the professional arena. His exceptional foresight and leadership were notably displayed when he successfully orchestrated a major collaboration with boAt, India’s leading audio product company, resulting in the production of innovative twin wireless speakers. Mr. Prithvi has been at the forefront of Dixon’s ambitious expansion, spearheading the establishment of a state-of-the-art facility in Chennai. Through strategic partnerships with industry giants like Asus and HP, he has driven the rapid growth of Dixon’s IT hardware division, solidifying its position as a key player in the tech manufacturing landscape. A proponent of continuous learning and global perspectives, Mr. Prithvi pursued a Master of Business Administration at the prestigious London Business School. Equipped with this advanced degree, he has played a pivotal role in Dixon’s mobile division, managing key accounts such as Jio and Xiaomi. His strategic insights and hands-on leadership have been instrumental in building strong partnerships and significantly contributing to the company’s success. Mr. Prithvi is committed to positioning Dixon Technologies as an engineering powerhouse. He is leading efforts to diversify into new product categories, ensuring that the company remains at the forefront of innovation and continues to scale new heights in the rapidly evolving tech industry.
